name: lshift
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::__lshift__.Tensor(Tensor self, Tensor other) -> Tensor. Performs elementwise integer left shift without mutating or aliasing either input. The suite also covers aten::__lshift__.Scalar(Tensor self, Scalar other) -> Tensor. Tests cover deterministic int16 and int32 values, Tensor and Scalar overloads, broadcasting, zero-sized and noncontiguous tensors, output metadata, input non-mutation, and invalid broadcasting.
